04 — QUESTIONS, ANSWERED STRAIGHT

What project teams actually ask

How do I invite David Architectural Metals to bid?

Start with the builder above, or call (773) 376-3200 / email info@davidarchitecturalmetals.com with your scope, drawings if you have them, and your bid timing. The summary the builder writes is designed to be read out on the call or pasted into an invitation to bid.

What is a monumental stair — and what kinds do you fabricate?

Monumental stairs are the large, architectural stairs that anchor a lobby or atrium. The firm's site-verified stair scope covers monumental, self-supporting, helical, and multi-level stairs. Bring the drawings and the stair's role in the building; the shop confirms what fits.

What canopy and catwalk scope can I ask about?

Canopies (overhead shelter in metal) and catwalks (elevated access in metal, with supports and railings as one system). Both are site-verified services. Because no dedicated canopy or catwalk photographs were verified for this page, those cards show representative metalwork detail photographs and say so plainly.

How are timelines set?

No standard timeline is published on this page, because none was verified. Timelines are confirmed per project by phone, once scope and drawings are in hand — ask about yours when you call, rather than assuming a standard lead time.

What should I include in my inquiry?

Project type, your role, stage (invitation to bid, budget pricing, or design development), timing, project location, and a scope description — plus whether you have drawings available. The builder above collects exactly that, in that order.
